title: The Assistant's chosen name shows everywhere the app says Assistant

requirements.text: Once named, every label, menu, tooltip and message the app shows uses the name instead of the word Assistant
requirements.check: eye: name it, then check dashboard, bar, pane header and menus

requirements.text: Renaming updates those labels without restarting the app
